# Zerops Provider

Manage Zerops projects and services. Sensitive values are retained in Terraform state; protect your state files.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    zerops = {
      source = "zeropsio/zerops"
    }
  }
}

provider "zerops" {
  # Explicit origin; token and organization_id come from environment.
  endpoint = "https://api.dev.example.test"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) HTTPS API origin. Defaults to ZEROPS_ENDPOINT, then the production Prague API.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization client ID. Defaults to ZEROPS_ORGANIZATION_ID; otherwise exactly one membership is required.
- `postgresql_min_disk_gb` (Number) PostgreSQL disk floor in GB, with at most three decimal places. Defaults to ZEROPS_POSTGRESQL_MIN_DISK_GB, then 2. The platform currently fails to provision PostgreSQL below this floor (generic HTTP 500 error). Lower or raise it when Zerops fixes the catalog.
- `routing_force_sync` (Boolean) Allow synchronizing foreign staged routing changes. Defaults to ZEROPS_ROUTING_FORCE_SYNC, then false.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Integration token. Defaults to ZEROPS_TOKEN. No sudo escalation is performed.
